Looking at past September Apple events dating back to 2018, Apple's stock consistently sells off on the news day of and/or the coming days post event. Not significantly, but definitely tradeable around (peep what $TSLA did this past week on the "buy the rumor, sell the news" event).

Then it recovers all the somewhat shallow losses shortly thereafter.

Just a potential playbook for AAPL this week.
